text:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: Critical - Serving runtime errors impacting inference in eu-west-1. Affected service: redwood-serve-prod. Incident created: 3332100245

amanda: I’m on it, paging runtime eng and infra. brief summary? :eyes:

maria: hitting a cluster-wide spike of CUDA OOMs + container restarts on nodes in rack-7. Also seeing high packet retransmits on IB fabric. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/infb/metrics (embedding)

sanjay: interesting — logs show repeated `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` across replicas for model-embed-34. Example snippet:```
2026-03-12T09:30:12Z model-embed-34[replica-12]: runtime: allocation failed: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY size=2147483648
stack: serve/runtime/alloc.go:412
```

dave: infra telemetry shows intermittent link-downs on HCA-3/4 in rack-7, then rx_retransmit surge. Captured `ibstat` summary:```
HCA-3: LinkUp (port 1)
HCA-3: LinkDown (port 2)
rx_errors: 0 -> 1e5 (10s)
link_retries: 240
```

amanda: customer-impact? any requests failing?

customer-success: we have one enterprise customer (acme-pay) reporting 5xx rates for embedding endpoints since ~09:28 UTC. They see request timeouts ~6-8s then 502s.

maria: correlate: KV cache misses spiked when replicas restarted, causing heavier memory usage and longer sequences -> OOM. Also RDMA retransmits cause RPCs to block and queue up, increasing tail latency.

oncall-june: handoff in 10m. amanda, please capture mitigation steps so next oncall can pick up.

amanda: running mitigations now: 1) cordon + drain most-affected nodes (rack-7), 2) enable CPU-fallback routing for critical customers, 3) increase per-replica memory quota temporarily. Doing 1) now.

sanjay: to drain:```
kubectl cordon node-rack7-03
kubectl drain node-rack7-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
```

dave: hold on draining all nodes in rack-7 at once. HCA fabric is topologically sensitive; if you drain everything we might push load to other racks and trigger similar reflows. Drain one node at a time, wait 3m between. Also I'll run a fabric health probe.

amanda: ack — will do one-at-a-time. starting node-rack7-03 drain.

maria: routing changes in progress: switching `critical-customers` route to fallback-model-cpu (lower perf but stable). Patch sent to router:```
PATCH /routes/critical-customers
{ "target": "fallback-model-cpu", "weight": 100 }
```

oncall-june: note for handoff: set incident severity to SEV2 if customer-facing revenue impact persists after mitigations.

sanjay: found a heap of repeated cudaMalloc failures correlated with IB timeouts in kernel logs:```
[  501.123456] mlx5_core 0000:03:00.0: rxe: flush_recv_queue: timeout waiting for completion
[  501.123789] workqueue: kworker/u16:13 blocked for more than 120 seconds
```

dave: running `ibdiag` probe now, will post raw counters. If we see large RX drop ratios, plan is to failover HCA via `ipmi` power-cycle of NIC or rebind driver, depending on fabric vendor guidance. That's disruptive; prefer repair path without node reboot if possible.

amanda: pinging infra on boot window?

dave: low-risk step: disable GRO/TSO on affected interfaces to reduce reassembly pressure. Command:```
sudo ethtool -K mlx5_0 gro off tso off gso off
```
Applying to node-rack7-03 now.

maria: metrics: after routing change we see 60% drop in 5xx for critical customers, but overall cluster 5xx still elevated. KV cache population is slow — consider warming cache for high-volume keys.

oncall-june: will take over in 8m. amanda, leave an exec summary in the incident system and link this thread.

amanda: summary written: `Inc 3332100245 - IB link flaps in rack-7 causing RDMA retransmits -> RPC stalls -> container restarts & CUDA OOMs. Mitigations: staged drains, CPU-fallback routing, disable NIC offloads, temporary memory quota increases.`

sanjay: one more diagnostic: `nvidia-smi dmon` during flaps shows GPU mem used then sudden drop as process killed by OOM — repeated cycles. Suspect memory fragmentation from long-running process restarts + large batch requests. Recommend temporarily reducing max_batch_size for embed models.

maria: pushing config change to router to cap batch size to 8 for embed models:```
PATCH /model-configs/embed-34
{ "max_batch_size": 8 }
```

dave: infra note: fabric vendor recommends checking firmware version on HCAs; scheduling out-of-band maintenance tomorrow if we see recurrence. For immediate mitigation, I've temporarily moved traffic away from HCA-4 on rack-7 to HCA-1/2.

amanda: customers: acme-pay reporting improved latencies after fallback routing. CS will validate. :white_check_mark:

customer-success: acme-pay: confirming much better behavior now, ETA for full validation 20m.

oncall-june: taking handoff. Current state: mitigations in flight, customer impact reduced, ongoing infra investigation. I'll keep this thread as primary comms. Paging escalation if 5xx reappears for >=2 customers.

amanda: thanks — leaving logs and runbook links: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/infb-link-flap.md

sanjay: follow-up actions (todo): 1) postmortem checklist, 2) schedule firmware audit for HCAs in prod, 3) tweak memory alloc heuristics to reduce OOM cascade.

dave: created infra ticket INFRA-7891 for firmware + NIC config, assigned to netops.

oncall-june: closing pager but keeping thread open until metrics stable. :lock: 

amanda: thanks all. :pray:

pagerduty-bot: Incident 3332100245 acknowledged by oncall-june.
